content.data: At BairesDev, I joined Native Cos during the build phase of a new Shopify storefront and contributed through go-live and post-launch iterations.
The scope combined fast feature delivery with production hardening across conversion-critical surfaces, especially for mobile traffic and recurring merchandising updates.

data: Delivered 70+ pull requests in a ~5-month cycle.
Built a scroll-animation-driven section for landing experiences.
Implemented and refined PDP, cart, variant listing, and scent-related experiences.
Shipped iterative enhancements from early build stages through production release.
Improved bundle/subscription-related flows, including Recharge-related journeys.
Adjusted pricing, product-card behavior, and variant presentation for clearer purchase paths.
Supported merchandising-focused updates with quick turnaround and consistent QA.
Delivered repeated mobile and Safari/iOS fixes across key storefront interactions.
Applied iterative accessibility improvements in navigation and product-focused modules.
Balanced release speed with maintainability in a high-change production environment.

content.data: For over four years, I worked as the primary Shopify web developer for Decathlon US operations, covering both day-to-day delivery and long-term technical evolution.
The role required balancing enterprise reliability with continuous feature velocity across storefront architecture, performance, accessibility, analytics, and brand-driven UX changes.

data: Implemented new storefronts and large redesign cycles in a high-traffic retail context.
Built and evolved PDP, homepage, navigation, and content sections across recurring release cycles.
Supported brand-specific adaptations, including Van Rysel storefront requirements.
Led Core Web Vitals initiatives with ongoing optimization passes for LCP/CLS and rendering behavior.
Implemented accessibility improvement cycles across carousels, menus, forms, and PDP components.
Integrated quality checks into development flow to maintain standards during fast delivery.
Migrated analytics to GA4 with e-commerce event validation and tracking consistency controls.
Contributed to Hydrogen v2 setup, tooling, and initial design-system alignment.
Implemented Shopify Function-based customizations and integration-oriented enhancements when required.

content.data: Within the Decathlon ecosystem, I adapted theme architecture for Van Rysel's brand and product experience requirements.

data: Customized PDP and navigation behaviors for cycling-specific use cases.
Implemented geometry/size related UX components.
Expanded metafield-driven content for maintainable merchandising.

content.data: For around a decade, I led full stack development efforts for TerraCotta, combining storefront growth, internal system development, and operational integration with Shopify.
This was a long-cycle product environment where I worked across architecture, implementation, and business-critical workflows from end to end.

data: Led Shopify theme development and continuous storefront evolution across multiple versions.
Implemented recurring UX, SEO, and performance improvements for conversion and maintainability.
Handled feature delivery from backlog definition to production rollout.
Built an in-house ERP integrated with Shopify APIs and webhook-driven synchronization flows.
Supported core business operations such as product, order, and stock-related processes.
Created internal workflows to reduce manual operations and improve data consistency.
Evolved stack decisions over time based on business maturity and maintainability needs.
Worked across PHP, Node.js, Vue.js, and MySQL in long-term production contexts.
Maintained multi-version architecture while keeping delivery cadence and system reliability.
